2645-3430-3756-4644.easyPrerequisites: Tidewater Minion doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3430-3756-4644.description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Izzet Boilerworks
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

643-4881-6909-8200.manaNeeded: {3}{B}{R} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
643-4881-6909-8200.description:
Cast Grub's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

679-3966-7863--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
679-3966-7863--165.description:
Draw a card.
Human Torch triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lich's Mastery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

586-1739-4247-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

586-864-997-2267-3125.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-997-2267-3125.description:
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Tormod.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

225-2557-4772-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3756-5147-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Izzet Boilerworks.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Izzet Boilerworks from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

4285-7683.notablePrerequisites: You have another instant or sorcery card in hand with the mana to cast it and applicable target(s) if needed.
4285-7683.description:
Cast any other instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Increasing Vengeance by paying its mana cost, targeting the instant or sorcery cast in step 1.
Increasing Vengeance's storm ability triggers, creating at least one copy of Increasing Vengeance targeting the original Increasing Vengeance.
Resolve a copy of Increasing Vengeance, copying Increasing Vengeance targeting the original Increasing Vengeance.
Repeat step 4.

670-1619-6144-6966.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-6144-6966.description:
Cast All-Fates Stalker by paying its mana cost.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the All-Fates Stalker trigger, exiling Goliath Paladin until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice All-Fates Stalker.
All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, causing Goliath Paladin to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Goliath Paladin enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Goliath Paladin trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning All-Fates Stalker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the All-Fates Stalker trigger, exiling Goliath Paladin until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice All-Fates Stalker.
Repeat from step 5.

3490-4050-7173-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-7173-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heroic Feast trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

2724-3194-4499.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Emiel the Blessed. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1362-1479-2374.description:
Play Oboro, Palace in the Clouds.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Maja and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Oboro from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Maja triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

206-1445-5477.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one creature card in your hand.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
206-1445-5477.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning any other creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2308-3641-4050-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2308-3641-4050-4871.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {1}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Distinguished Conjurer trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-6972-7230.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have lost 2 or more life this turn.
413-6972-7230.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cryptborn Horror.
When Cryptborn Horror dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Cryptborn Horror enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1409-2397-3671.description:
Activate Wily Goblin by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Wily Goblin enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Wily Goblin.
Resolve both Wily Goblin triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

3480-3490-4289-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3480-3490-4289-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1183-3436-4853.description:
Activate Worn Powerstone by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Pentavite.
When the Pentavite dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Worn Powerstone.
Resolve the Pentavus ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

141-2034-3505.description:
Cast Second Sunrise by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Second Sunrise.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Second Sunrise
Resolve the Second Sunrise copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

132-4851-5200.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Timeless Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.
132-4851-5200.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

1350-6470-6751.description:
Cast Iridescent Tiger by paying {4}{R}.
When Iridescent Tiger enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Iridescent Tiger from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4055-4131-4222-6657.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {6} and tapping it, copying Basalt Monolith's ability three times.
Resolve a copy of Basalt Monolith's ability, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 4 two additional times.
Activate Energy Refractor by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Gogo.
Repeat from step 3.

2060-3750-6599.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Maester Seymour triggers, putting at least five +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

1029-4137-5028.description:
Activate Blossom-Clad Werewolf by tapping it, adding {2}.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Blossom-Clad Werewolf.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
1029-4137-5028.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

1698-3260-3540-5645.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four creatures.
You have at least three opponents.
1698-3260-3540-5645.description:
Cast Mourning by paying 2 life if able, or {B} otherwise.
Each creature you control's extort ability triggers.
Resolve the first extort trigger, causing you to pay 2 life if able, or {W/B} otherwise, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining extort trigger.
Resolve Mourning, attaching it to a creature you control.
Activate Mourning by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat until an opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
1698-3260-3540-5645.notes: Once you have two or less opponents, the combo no longer makes enough life to continue. You may repeat the loop using your own resources as desired.

501-586-2292-5258-5618.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1669-4826-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
1669-4826-5720-5721.description:
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Arcehlos.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

771-2980-3341.notablePrerequisites:
Glamdring attached to Charnelhoard Wurm.
Charnelhoard Wurm does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Charnelhoard Wurm.
771-2980-3341.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Charnelhoard Wurm.
Charnelhoard Wurm and Glamdring trigger.
Resolve the Charnelhoard Wurm trigger, returning Savage Beating from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Glamdring trigger, casting Savage Beating without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Savage Beating, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

342-674-3080-3537.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exhcange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, switching the text boxes of Bog Initiate and Syr Ginger.
Activate Syr Ginger by paying {0}, adding {B}.
Repeat step 3.

397-4231-4321.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure token.
397-4231-4321.description:
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing a Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token as well as a Food, Clue and Treasure artifact token.
Repeat.

2585-2645-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Grim Monolith's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
2585-2645-3918.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Staff of Domination's other abilities via Trazyn.

360-1981-4435-4591-4740.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least fifty.
360-1981-4435-4591-4740.description:
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying fifty life, dealing fifty damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, creating fifty 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
The Soldiers enter the battlefield, triggering Soul Warden fifty times, gaining you 100 life.
Repeat.

2357-4992.description:
Stormtide Leviathan causes all lands to be Islands in addition to their other types.
Curse of Marit Lage prevents Islands from untapping during their controller's untap steps.

1987-2510-4125-4714.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
1987-2510-4125-4714.description:
Activate Mana Geode by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Mana Geode and Shipwreck Dowser, blinking them.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Mana Geode enters the battlefield, scry 1.
Repeat.

2103-2665-4125.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Shipwreck Dowser.
2103-2665-4125.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Shipwreck Dowser.
When the token Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
